evidence_quotes.agenda: Post-booking kickoff call re-confirming logistics — no quid pro quo framing or dedicated agenda question either way.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern was raised — the customer volunteered new garage/appliance items (washer/dryer, fridge) that the rep simply re-quoted for, scored N/A/full-credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'this is just an estimate... we only factored in a little extra time' + 'if the move goes faster than expected... you pay less' — no rate-lock/100k line, no self-prep tip, no genuine 'does that feel fair' pause.

top_strength: Caught and properly re-quoted for garage items (washer/dryer, fridge, tools) the customer hadn't mentioned in the original online request, instead of letting them slip through to move day.
coaching_note: Full differentiator block and personalized estimate were delivered well, but the close still skipped the rate-lock language even on a call that ended in a confirmed booking.
